title: Per-target — everything hangs off a target

text.insert: The target is the worker's unit of work and the center of knowledge retrieval. Its current graph node connects computed structure, alternate search axes, prior attempts, tactic views, and present-anchored learnings.

steps.text: Read its code-graph card and one-hop relationships
Sweep opseq, Ghidra, sibling, and crosswalk indexes
Follow related targets to attempt records and tactic outcomes
Read anchored learnings and chase evidence only when needed
Query shared corpus and standards for cross-target context

rows: Code graph

Attempt ledger

Knowledge ledger
Symbol and file subjects project onto current target anchors.
Curated records append; graph projection rebuilds.
Evidence-backed meaning, confidence, and lifecycle status.

text.insert: A completed knowledge rebuild produces CALLS, REFERENCES_DATA, SIBLING_OF, ANALOGOUS_TO, and HAS_LEARNING relationships when their inputs resolve. The current Melee projection contains 124,247 CALLS edges, 8,789 REFERENCES_DATA edges, and 3,051 SIBLING_OF edges.
